Subject: Requesting provisional PO and spend cap allocation for onboarding

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. We're ready to move into production and need a provisional PO to start procurement while our legal and contracts finalize the master agreement. Can you issue a provisional PO (provisionally capped at $75,000) and split the cap across the following line items:

- Integration services (SKU INT-001): $40,000
- Monthly hosting (SKU HST-010): $25,000
- One-time setup (SKU SET-003): $10,000

We completed the onboarding form and attached it for your procurement team. We also need the PO number to begin invoicing for the initial milestone.

Attachments: Stratus_Onboarding_Form.pdf

Let me know if you need W-9 or bank info and whether the three-line split is acceptable. If needed, we can consolidate items to two lines.

Best,
Anna Gomez
Head of Finance
Stratus Integrations

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Requesting provisional PO and spend cap allocation for onboarding

Hi Anna —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the completed form. A couple of quick asks so procurement can move forward:

1) Please attach a completed W-9 and preferred ACH details (bank name, routing, account last 4). We need those to create the vendor profile.
2) Confirm the legal entity name to be used on the PO (full registered name).
3) Procurement prefers a maximum of three lines, but we will treat the hosting line as a rolling monthly allocation. If you need consolidation, note which two SKUs you want combined.

We will issue a provisional PO with prefix PO-PROV-2026- and raise an internal ticket (PR-4521) for final PO number mapping once contracts clear. Expect provisional PO issuance within 48 business hours after W-9 and ACH are provided.

For visibility I've looped in Laura (finance) for spend-cap approval and Marcus for SKU mapping.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Hi Irene —

Thanks, attached are the W-9 (W9_Stratus_Inc.pdf) and a bank ACH stub. Registered name for invoices: Stratus Integrations, Inc.

Regarding line items — we'd prefer to keep Integration services and One-time setup separate. If that helps speed things up, you can consolidate the hosting line into a single rolling monthly SKU (HST-010) and cap it at $25k.

Let me know when the provisional PO number is available so we can schedule the first milestone invoice.

Cheers,
Anna
